cohort: 306 patients with leiomyoma undergoing elective cesarean operations, of whom 82 underwent myomectomy and 224 did not.
finding: Myomectomy performed during cesarean section did not increase intrapartum or early postpartum morbidity, although it resulted in significantly longer operation and hospital durations.
mod_finding: Myomectomy performed during cesarean section did not increase intrapartum or early postpartum morbidity.
followup_time: Up to the duration of hospital stay (early postpartum)
